items.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018
items.q: one of the members of my team is right there, Miles Weinstein, and I have a great band and we all work together.

ctx.x: And congratulations on your career so far.

Oh, thank you. I have a great team of people and one of the members of my team is right there, Miles Weinstein, and I have a great band and we all work together. We’re like a team and we just push each other forward.
